description: This file defines the main activity 'LauncherActivity' for a multi-display Android launcher app. It manages display selection, app grid, pinned apps, app launching, and UI interactions including animations and configuration changes. The activity integrates with view models for app data, handles user actions to launch apps or set wallpapers, and supports multi-display configurations.

classes.name: LauncherActivity
classes.description: Main activity implementing a multi-display launcher interface, managing UI components, app launching, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, adapters, view models, and event listeners.

methods.name: onMenuItemClick
methods.description: Handles popup menu item clicks such as adding app shortcuts and setting wallpapers.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes like orientation change, hides app drawer.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides back button to hide the app drawer instead of exiting.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents; hides keyboard and resets app drawer.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an app intent with display options, handles exceptions showing an alert if it fails.

methods.name: refreshDisplayPicker
methods.description: Refreshes the display selection dropdown with current displays.

methods.name: showAppDrawer
methods.description: Shows or hides the app drawer with animation and updates UI visibility.

methods.name: revealAnimator
methods.description: Creates a circular reveal animator for showing or hiding the app drawer.
